Pashm takes its name from the finest wool, the soul of the Kashmiri shawl, gathered from the high cold mountains and woven into heirlooms. This ivory marina ensemble is embroidered in detailed panels of Kashmiri-inspired motifs. Flowing paisleys, trailing florals and a central tree of life bloom in rose, coral, turquoise and gold. A grand heritage border of boteh motifs anchors the hem and echoes along the sleeves. A contrasting tea pink marina shawl with ornate embroidered pallus adds a blush of warmth, and ivory marina trousers complete the look. It is softness woven with heritage, made for winter's embrace.

Samarkand takes its name from the legendary Silk Route city of sapphire domes and royal courts, where caravans rested after crossing the desert. This navy marina ensemble features a heavily embroidered Kashmiri-inspired yoke. Sweeping paisleys and florals are worked in ivory, sky blue and soft rust, and they flow into detailed sleeves, organza sleeve pattis and embroidered pockets. A beige marina shawl, scattered with delicate motifs and framed by an ornate border and pallu, brings the warmth of desert sand to the deep blue. Solid marina trousers complete a look that is majestic, well-travelled and timeless through winter.
